full_judgment: 2. The appellant's father late Basharatullah was the owner of .70 acres of land of C. S. plot No. 1363, mouza Faidabad under P. S. Cantonment, District Dhaka. .52 acres out of eastern portion thereof which is the case land was requisitioned on 19-3-58 in L. A. Case No. 66/57-58 under the then East Bengal (Emergency) Requisition of Property Act, 1948. Late Basharatullah challenged the said requisition in Title Suit No. 193 of 1969 of the 1st Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka and obtained a decree against the Government on 22-3-73. The Government derequisitioned the case land by a Gazette Notification dated 28-3-83 and restored its possession to the owner on 3-11-83. No compensation was paid for use and occupation of the requisitioned case land for 28 years. The case land was sought to be acquired under the Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Property Ordinance, 1982 (Ordinance No. II of 1982), shortly the Ordinance, for respondent No. 2, the Civil Aviation Authority and a notice of acquisition was served on the appellant's father on 28-5-83 in L.A. Case No. 48/83-84 and a notice under section 6 of the Ordinance was served on him on 21-6-84 to which the appellant's father filed written objections. The requiring body did not place the requisite fund at the disposal of the acquiring authority within time and the acquisition proceeding abated under Section 12(1) of the Ordinance with effect from 18-12-84 by a Gazette Notification dated 13-1-85. A fresh L.A. proceeding bearing the same number was started once again in respect of the case land and in favour of the same requiring body and a fresh notice under section 3 was also served on 5-5-85. The appellant's father was paid Tk. 22 lakhs as compensation before possession was taken and on 11-4-86 the appellant's father died. After his death the appellant filed Arbitration Revision No. 4 of 1986 in the Court of the Arbitrator and First Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka claiming a total sum of Tk. 3,44.60,000/= by way of compensation. Both respondent Nos. 1 and 2 filed separate written objections thereto. The Appellant, respondent No. 1 and respondent No 2 examined one witness each. The Arbitrator by an award dated 30-6-87 awarded to the appellant an amount of Tk. 1,04,50,000/= with 10% interest from the date of the award till realisation. Respondent No. 1, the Government of Bangladesh represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka and respondent No. 2, the Civil Aviation Authority filed Arbitration Appeal Nos. 1 and 2 of 1987 respectively before the Arbitration Appellate Tribunal and District Judge, Dhaka who allowed the appeals on contest in part and reduced the award to a sum of Tk. 61,02,000/= with 15% interest from the date of the award till realisation.
